execution_rule: Re-verify every dynamic platform fact against a current official source or authorized interface before using it in a decision.

published_mechanism: Sponsored Products are cost-per-click ads using keyword, product or automatic targeting.
Bid strategy can use fixed bids or dynamic adjustments based on real-time signals.
Product availability, targeting relevance, placements and adjusted bids are observable parts of delivery.
undisclosed: No official fixed A9, COSMOS or ad-ranking factor weights are registered.
The complete auction and relevance model is not observable.
forbidden_inferences: Do not write A9 or COSMOS weights as an advertising auction formula.
Do not treat suggested bids, attributed sales or New-to-brand as causal incrementality.
records.execution_refresh: Verify marketplace, product, placement, bidding controls and retail eligibility in the current console.

published_mechanism: Ad Rank uses bid, auction-time ad and landing-page quality, thresholds, auction competitiveness, search context and expected asset or format impact.
Ad Rank is calculated for eligibility and again for ranking relative to other eligible ads.
The visible 1-10 Quality Score is a diagnostic tool and is not an auction input.
undisclosed: Google does not publish a fixed multiplicative Ad Rank equation or factor weights.
Auction-time quality and automated-bidding model internals are not fully observable.
forbidden_inferences: Do not state Ad Rank = bid x Quality Score x ad format impact.
Do not optimize or aggregate visible Quality Score as if it were the auction score.
records.execution_refresh: Verify current matching, bidding, experiment, asset and reporting behavior in official help and the authorized account.

published_mechanism: Shopping ads use Merchant Center product data rather than keywords to match products with searches.
Product data, campaign settings, landing pages, images and other signals can affect eligibility, matching and ad construction.
For eligible Search and Performance Max candidates, Google publicly describes Ad Rank as a multi-factor auction-time mechanism.
undisclosed: Cross-channel allocation weights and the full Performance Max decision logic are not public.
Visible channel or asset reports are not the complete delivery model.
forbidden_inferences: Do not infer fixed channel weights from reported slices.
Do not attribute feed repair, brand demand and budget changes to one mechanism when changed together.
records.execution_refresh: Verify Merchant Center eligibility, product-data version and account-visible Performance Max controls.

published_mechanism: Meta describes auction total value using advertiser bid, estimated action rate and ad quality.
Audience selection determines which ads can enter an auction for a person.
Delivery learns from new information and narrows toward people estimated to be more likely to take the optimized action.
undisclosed: Meta does not publish stable factor weights or the complete estimated-action-rate model.
Account diagnostics and learning labels are not the auction formula.
forbidden_inferences: Do not convert the three published components into invented fixed weights.
Do not equate platform-attributed conversions or learning completion with causal incrementality.
records.execution_refresh: Verify current objective, bidding, attribution, automation and measurement controls in the authorized account.

published_mechanism: TikTok states that auction performance can depend on bidding strategy, creative, audience settings and account structure.
Maximum Delivery and Cost Cap are exposed bidding-control families for supported objectives and campaign types.
TikTok separately publishes organic For You recommendation signals such as interactions, video information and device or account settings.
undisclosed: TikTok does not publish a fixed paid-auction ranking equation or cold-start pool size.
Organic For You recommendation factors are not a paid-ad auction formula.
forbidden_inferences: Do not use organic For You signals as proof of paid-auction weighting.
Do not invent a cold-start pool size, paid ranking weight or deterministic creative score.
records.execution_refresh: Verify objective, market, bid control, optimization event, attribution and Spark authorization in Ads Manager.

published_mechanism: TikTok publicly describes organic recommendation signals, but this evidence is adjacent context rather than a Shop paid-delivery formula.
undisclosed: The complete interaction among paid Shop delivery, organic recommendation, live traffic and commerce distribution is not public.
forbidden_inferences: Do not transfer organic For You factors into GMV Max or Shop Ads weights.
Do not merge natural, creator and paid GMV without an authorized attribution and order ledger.
records.execution_refresh: Require current official Shop documentation and an authorized market-specific interface before naming controls or mechanism claims.

undisclosed: No cross-market official fixed auction formula is registered in this repository snapshot.
forbidden_inferences: Do not copy another Shopee market's controls, fields or thresholds.
Do not merge ads, vouchers, flash sales, free shipping or subsidies into one attributed mechanism.
records.execution_refresh: Obtain current market-specific official help or authorized Seller Centre evidence before mechanism claims.

undisclosed: A standard self-service merchant advertising auction cannot be assumed across cooperation modes and markets.
forbidden_inferences: Do not import CPC auction mechanics from Amazon, Meta or Google.
Do not create ROAS when no verifiable advertising report and cost ledger exist.
records.execution_refresh: Classify cooperation mode and obtain current contract, official help, console and settlement evidence.

undisclosed: Merchant-controllable advertising and platform-controlled pricing, events or distribution are not assumed to be the same mechanism.
forbidden_inferences: Do not invent budget, bid or target-ROAS controls.
Do not describe price verification or event eligibility as an advertising traffic button.
records.execution_refresh: Verify country, merchant mode, current official documentation, authorized controls and settlement evidence.

undisclosed: No single cross-country fixed ranking equation is registered; products and reporting can differ by market.
forbidden_inferences: Do not copy target ROAS, controls or attribution fields across countries.
Do not interpret nominal growth without currency, inflation, reputation and delivery controls.
records.execution_refresh: Obtain current country-specific official help and authorized advertising, reputation and delivery evidence.
